articles.desc: Berlin: Die Zahl der Asylerstanträge ist in Deutschland deutlich zurückgegangen. Das berichtet die "Bild am Sonntag" und beruft sich auf das Bundesinnenministerium. articles.desc: Am Samstagabend wird die Polizei zu einem brennenden Haus in Pfullendorf alarmiert. Fünf Bewohner können sich selbst in Sicherheit bringen. Verletzt wurde bei dem Brand am Samstagabend niemand. Fünf Bewohner des Hauses konnten sich den Angaben zufolge selbst nach draußen retten. articles.title: Engineers teach spacecraft to 'dream' their way to the space station
articles.desc: Docking with the ISS may seem simple. However, actually doing so shows how difficult orbital mechanics can be. It's like traveling down a highway at 28,000 km/hr (17,000 mph) and parallel parking in an open garage on a multibillion-dollar laboratory traveling at the same speed. If you try to accelerate forward, you actually drift up, and there's no air friction to naturally slow you down. Oh, and if you hit the lab, everyone aboard both your craft and the station dies, and the resulting debris field could wipe out dozens of satellites and even harm people on the ground. No pressure, obviously.

articles.title: Digital textbooks significantly boost students' intrinsic learning motivation
articles.desc: A research team from The Education University of Hong Kong (EdUHK) and East China Normal University (ECNU) has published a meta-analysis demonstrating the impact of digital textbooks (DTs) on student motivation. articles.desc: We are continuously sending information to each other, transmitting zeros and ones through a giant network of connected computers and devices. The motivation is not just scientific curiosity. Qubits can be a 0, a 1 or any superposition of the two. They can also become entangled, showing a degree of correlation that is out of reach for classical bits.

This usually comes from compassion for grieving military families. But compassion should not require us to erase meaningful distinctions our nation deliberately established.
